rationale: A commits to a technical-drawing art direction made for a Copenhagen audio object: a giant HALO wordmark behind the speaker with dimension callouts, 'sheet n of 7' section rules, polar and in-room response charts, a room plan and a bold orange pre-order close, and its entrance is fully choreographed and settled by about 1.3 s (leader lines draw, letters rise, speaker lifts in). B has lusher amber-lit renders, a pinned rotating object scene, a numbered exploded view and a draggable room heat-map, but its preloader is still at 93% at 3 s on desktop and its hero is never visible in the entrance or the first scroll frame, with the phone's first viewport also showing only the loader. B's dark-glow serif-italic styling also reads closer to a familiar premium template, while A's hover states (colour inversion, underline draw, logo fill) and mobile layout are clean and legible throughout.
